narration.prompt: [whispers] Alas-dos ng madaling-araw, may batang naglalaro sa ilalim ng mga mesa namin. [long pause] [softly] Call center agent ako noon. Graveyard shift, sa isang lumang building. [long pause] Jun-Jun ang tawag sa kanya ng mga matagal na. Huwag mo raw siyang pansinin. [long pause] Sa pagitan ng mga tawag, naririnig ko siyang tumatakbo sa likod ko. [long pause] Sa itim na monitor, nakita ko siya. Nakaupo sa paanan ko. [long pause] Nag-resign ako. Lumipat ng kumpanya, ibang building. [long pause] Unang gabi sa bagong floor, may humila sa kable ng headset ko. [long pause] [whispers] Pagsilip ko sa ilalim ng mesa... nandoon siya. Sumama pala siya.

callcenter-floor-loop.prompt: A large office call center floor at 2 a.m., mostly empty: air conditioning hum, computer fans, a few distant agents murmuring quietly into headsets, occasional keyboard typing, buzzing fluorescent lights, lonely late-night ambience.

small-feet-running.prompt: Small bare feet of a little child running quickly across office carpet behind you, light soft rapid footsteps passing from left to right, then stopping suddenly, quiet room.

faint-giggle.prompt: A single faint, breathy giggle of a small child, far away under a desk in a dark empty office, eerie, soft echo.

headset-tones.prompt: Call center headset sounds: a soft electronic incoming-call beep, a click, then the faint hiss of an open line, and a short disconnect tone.

cable-tug.prompt: A headset cable being tugged slowly in short jerks from under a desk, plastic cable scraping across the desk edge, a headset sliding on a laminate desk, then a small thud.

note: Picks made by measurement (RMS, peak), not by listening.
